description: This file defines the AuthProvider class implementing authentication state management using Flutter's ChangeNotifier. It interfaces with an AuthService to handle sign-in and sign-out actions via Google and maintains authentication state including current user, loading status, and error messages.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A provider class extending ChangeNotifier to manage authentication state and notify listeners upon changes.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AuthProvider with an AuthService instance and setting up a stream listener for auth state changes.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.description: Handles sign-in with Google, manages loading state, and updates error message upon failure.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the a user via the AuthService.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the auth state subscription and cleans up resources.
